user.title: Choose how the thermostat reaches Home Assistant
user.description: A trusted reverse proxy is recommended when it already manages local certificates. Direct TLS is available when Home Assistant owns a certificate the stock thermostat trusts.

reverse_proxy.title: Connect through a trusted reverse proxy
reverse_proxy.description: Enter the API hostname used by the thermostat. The proxy must preserve the Host, send one X-Forwarded-For address, and forward HTTP to Nuve Local. Leave the listen address blank for automatic detection.

direct_tls.title: Connect directly to Home Assistant
direct_tls.description: Enter the thermostat's API hostname and a certificate it trusts. Leave the listen address blank for automatic detection.

commissioning.title: Verify the thermostat before pairing
commissioning.description: Enter the values from the thermostat backup. After pairing, Nuve Local captures its starting state once. Control remains off until that state agrees with fresh data.

auxiliary_as_emergency.name: Auxiliary heat used as emergency heat

unsupported_firmware.title: Nuve firmware is not supported
unsupported_firmware.description: This firmware is not supported. Keep control off and install a Nuve Local release that supports the version shown on the thermostat.

canonical_baseline_problem.title: Nuve starting device state is incomplete
canonical_baseline_problem.description: Settings, Auto, or setup data is missing or disagrees with fresh thermostat data. Keep control off until Deployment status reports ready.

monitor_authority_stale.title: Nuve thermostat data is stale
monitor_authority_stale.description: The latest complete monitor record is missing, stale, or older than a Settings change. Check the network path and wait for fresh data.

persistence_problem.title: Nuve saved device state needs attention
persistence_problem.description: Home Assistant could not verify the saved thermostat state or recovered an earlier copy. Keep control off, check storage health, and preserve a backup before reloading.

uncertain_command_outcome.title: A Nuve command outcome is uncertain
uncertain_command_outcome.description: The thermostat fetched a command but did not confirm it. Do not retry. Compare Home Assistant with the thermostat and wait for fresh Settings, Auto, and monitor data.

schedule_authority_block.title: A Nuve schedule blocks Settings writes
schedule_authority_block.description: A schedule is active or its status is stale. Settings changes could erase it, so disable the schedule on the thermostat and wait for a fresh No Schedule update.

bootstrap_not_ready.message: Starting-state capture needs a paired online thermostat, control off, supported firmware, a verified technician URL, and no active firmware update.

combined_change_unsupported.message: Change the Nuve operating mode and temperature in separate actions.

invalid_auto_temperature.message: Auto mode requires low and high targets from 4 to 32 C in whole-degree increments.

auto_baseline_missing.message: The thermostat has not supplied both Auto temperature bounds.

invalid_auto_range.message: The Auto low temperature must be below the high temperature.

range_requires_auto.message: A temperature range can only be set while the thermostat is in Auto mode.

invalid_temperature.message: Use a target from 18 to 30 C in whole-degree increments.

unsupported_hvac_mode.message: That HVAC mode is not supported by the Nuve thermostat.

unsupported_fan_mode.message: Choose Auto, On, or Off for the Nuve fan mode.

invalid_fan_working_per_hour.message: Use a whole-number fan circulation time from 10 to 60 minutes per hour.

invalid_display_brightness.message: Use a whole-number display brightness from 0 to 100 percent.

invalid_night_mode_time.message: Use a local wall-clock time in HH:MM format with minute resolution.

control_disabled.message: Local thermostat control is disabled in the Nuve Local integration options.

control_not_ready.message: Local control is waiting for current device state. Resynchronization takes two five-second Settings polls and a fresh monitor upload; pairing, saved starting state, and a supported mode are also required.

control_busy.message: Another Nuve control request is already in progress.

control_state_changed.message: The thermostat was changed locally before this request could be delivered.

command_timeout.message: The thermostat did not fetch this request before it timed out; no change was delivered.

outcome_uncertain.message: The thermostat fetched this request but did not confirm the result. Further writes are blocked until fresh device state arrives.

runtime_stopped.message: The Nuve Local integration stopped before the request completed.
